fields.title: Build or Buy
fields.inputs/0/label: Payback period of the in-house solution
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: An A/B testing system is needed. Ready-made costs 280k/month. In-house takes 2.5 months of team time, then 40k/month in infrastructure and about 2 weeks per quarter for maintenance.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: How soon does the in-house solution pay off?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Which question is more important than the calculation?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: saves 240k/month, team development takes 2.5 months — at a team cost of about 1.2M/month that is 3M, plus maintenance ~600k/year. Payback is about 15 months. But the more important question: is A/B testing a competitive advantage? No. Therefore we buy, even with the payback. Plus the opportunity cost of 2.5 months of product work is not included in the calculation and usually exceeds the savings.
